verdict.rationale: Typesense's own install documentation lists a "Search UI Components" section, which suggests first-party UI components exist. Nothing in the pack describes what they are or which widgets they cover. Community comments only ask whether InstantSearch-style support exists, which is a question and not evidence either way. Missing for 10: documentation of the actual component library and supported frameworks, evidence of search box, results, facet and pagination widgets, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official UI component libraries let me assemble a full search interface — box, results, facets, pagination — without building it from scratch
